description: Country posts created for a specific one-off featured week but deliberately excluded from data/country-index.json: they are not part of the perpetual alphabetical rotation manifest, so Country_Manifest::entries() never includes them and they never affect rotation order, count, or any other country's schedule (Country_Repository::get_all_ordered(), count(), cycle_position_of(), etc. all stay exactly as if this file didn't exist). scripts/import-countries.php imports these the same way it imports manifest countries (post + manifest_key meta + continent/region terms), but each only ever actually appears on the site because data/schedule-overrides.json pins one specific date to its key. See docs/decisions/0006-temporary-schedule-overrides.md. As with the manifest's own stub countries, these posts get only name/continent/region here — full quick facts, summaries, and prayer & mission content still need to be authored and applied the same way any data/<key>.json content file is.
